scientific.integrity: The source SNGM recurrence is specialized to a deterministic scalar quadratic, where normalization removes curvature from the state dynamics. All source-initialized sign itineraries through period six are reduced to exact integer return polynomials, and both surviving resonance families are replayed directly.
limitations: Constant learning rate and source momentum initialization \(u_0=0\).
Only nonzero full-state returns through period six are classified.
Longer periodic orbits and stochastic minibatch dynamics are not classified.
The exact resonance momenta are diagnostic boundary cases rather than default deep-learning settings.

title: SNGM's first source-initialized momentum resonances occur at period six
